name: The Roman Method: To Be a Vampire
source:
An adventure into the dark and the supernatural…
Carl Jackson (First Name Changeable) has always been infatuated with the occult. Goblins, Werewolves, Fairies… Vampires.
But the older he got, the less he cared. It was all fake anyway, right?
Wrong.
Pushed to the edge by a drunk father threatening to throw him on the street and bullies making his life a living hell, Carl’s reality shatters when he finds a strange book waiting inside his locker.
This book? The Roman Method.
The key to claiming true power and changing his life forever.
translation:
一场深入黑暗与超自然领域的奇异冒险……
卡尔·杰克逊（名字可自由更改）从小便对神秘学痴迷不已——哥布林、狼人、妖精……还有吸血鬼。
然而随着年龄增长，他渐渐对这些失去了兴趣。反正全都是骗人的玩意儿，对吧？
大错特错。
一边是酗酒成性、扬言要把他赶出家门的父亲，一边是令他生不如死的校园恶霸——被逼到绝境的卡尔在储物柜里发现了一本古怪的书，他所熟知的现实也随之彻底粉碎。
这本书的名字？《罗马秘法》。
一把能够助他攫取真正力量、永远改写命运的钥匙。
